singapore.title: Singapore air quality enters unhealthy range in three regions
singapore.summary: PSI readings have dipped in and out of the unhealthy range over the past weeks.

singapore.title: Defending champion Shanti Pereira tops heats, advances to Asian Games 200m finals
singapore.summary: Shanti Pereira clocked a time of 23.10s and was the top qualifier in the women's 200m heats.

singapore.title: Helping the bereaved find closure: Singapore officers deployed to Nepal floods return home
singapore.summary: A total of 35 police and forensic officers were deployed to Nepal to provide specialist support in disaster victim identification and aerial surveillance.

singapore.title: Mamma Mia Focaccia, which drew queues for its Italian sandwiches, closes after less than a year
singapore.summary: The Amoy Street deli cited rising costs for its closure. Its hidden champagne bar, The Champagnery, has also shuttered.

singapore.title: Singapore's Loh Kean Yew beats India's Lakshya Sen, advances to Asian Games round of 16
singapore.summary: The Singaporean will next face Malaysia's Justin Hoh later on Saturday.

singapore.title: Man to be charged after allegedly starting fire in front of mosque
singapore.summary: The police found that an oil tin had been placed at the entrance of a mosque at 80 Raffles Place, with an undergarment placed inside and set ablaze.

singapore.title: With rent of nearly S$10,000, can this Yishun family keep selling S$2 nasi lemak as costs rise?
singapore.summary: His parents see their stall’s best-known dish as a way of giving back, leaving second-generation owner Adam Danish to make the numbers work. CNA’s Money Mind finds out what the family must do.

singapore.title: 'Unwavering belief': The long-time coach pushing Singapore star swimmer Gan Ching Hwee to new heights
singapore.summary: Gan Ching Hwee smashed three national records at the 2026 Asian Games, taking silver in her events. Her long-time coach Eugene Chia spoke to CNA about their journey so far.

singapore.title: HDB scales up robotics and automation solutions to increase construction productivity at BTO sites
singapore.summary: The government will also further standardise precast components, with productivity gains that could translate into projects being completed earlier, said Minister for National Development Chee Hong Tat.

singapore.title: Govt reviewing property purchases by rail planning officers between 2007 and 2011 after working paper allegations
singapore.summary: The statistical patterns are concerning, but do not by themselves establish whether officers had access to non-public information about MRT stations or if it influenced property purchases, says the Public Service Division.

singapore.title: What happens after an animal dies at the Singapore Zoo? Meet the vet who investigates every death
singapore.summary: Dr Hsu Chia-Da is the only pathologist at Mandai Wildlife Group. CNA follows him inside the post-mortem room to see how clues uncovered after death can help zookeepers and veterinarians improve animal care.

singapore.title: Singapore now a 'super-aged' society, with more than 1 in 5 citizens aged 65 and above
singapore.summary: The number of Singaporeans aged 80 and above has also grown by 60 per cent over the past 10 years.

singapore.title: Singapore parents increasingly value holistic development, but academic concerns persist: IPS study
singapore.summary: The study by the Institute of Policy Studies looked at how parental mindsets towards education have changed over the last 10 years.

singapore.title: Supervisor gets jail after worker dies from electrocution during solar panel maintenance at Singapore Expo
singapore.summary: Ramalingam Kumaresan failed to ensure that not more than 20 solar panels were connected in a series. Investigations found that 79 panels were connected, deviating from the plan shared with an electrician on his team.

singapore.title: Potential StarHub-M1 merger could create stronger rival to Singtel but reduce consumer perks, say analysts
singapore.summary: StarHub and Keppel have confirmed they are in talks over a potential deal, months after a proposed acquisition of M1 by rival Simba fell through.

world.title: Boeing flags 737 MAX software glitch affecting landing navigation feature: Report
world.summary: A Boeing 737 MAX software glitch could knock out automated flight guidance during landing after a missed approach, adding fresh scrutiny to the jetmaker.

world.title: Thousands march in Madrid to protest Spain's housing crisis after eviction of 87-year-old woman
world.summary: Maricarmen Abascal's eviction after a 275% rent hike fuels fresh pressure on Pedro Sanchez's government to curb evictions and rising housing costs.

world.title: China, US agree to AI dialogue, tariff cuts on US$30 billion in goods during Xi visit
world.summary: The tariff reductions would apply to US exports such as agricultural goods, wood and cosmetics, as well as US imports including small appliances, toys, decorations, said the White House.

world.title: Trump predicts Cuba and US will make a deal
world.summary: Fuel shortages and blackouts grip Cuba as Donald Trump says the US can strike a deal with Havana without military action.

world.title: Hundreds of thousands in Paris cheer Pope Leo in largest event of French tour
world.summary: An estimated 800,000 people pack the Champs-Élysées as Pope Leo tells Catholics faith, not material things, brings true happiness.

world.title: China pushes back against US on Iran and Cuba in UN speech
world.summary: Respect for Gulf sovereignty and an end to pressure on Cuba dominated China’s UN speech, as Chinese Vice President Han Zheng pushed back without naming the US.

world.title: Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Hormuz and end fighting
world.summary: "They want to make a deal to open the Hormuz Strait immediately because they're losing so badly," US President Donald Trump said.

world.title: Six dead after explosion destroys building in Athens
world.summary: The blast - near some of Athens' most visited sites including the Acropolis and the Temple of Zeus - damaged nearby houses, shops and cars and sent rubble and broken glass as far as three blocks away.

world.title: China says it 'respects' Trump's 'super intelligence' switch from AI
world.summary: Beijing's foreign ministry said on Saturday (Sep 26) it "attaches importance" to US President Donald Trump's adoption of the term "super intelligence".

world.title: CNN blocked from Trump trip on Saturday
world.summary: The White House schedule only listed a "Secondary TV" correspondent and crew: Lindell TV - a staunchly pro-Trump outlet run by his close ally, businessman Mike Lindell.

world.title: Six big takeaways from a turbulent week of UN diplomacy
world.summary: While no breakthroughs were reached on the world's most intractable conflicts, talks on the Iran and Ukraine wars inched forward and global powers used the venue to debate AI risks with industry leaders.

world.title: OpenAI says its AI agents posted user images online in error
world.summary: Links to 53 images that were uploaded by ChatGPT users were accidentally posted onto online sites without the company's knowledge.

world.title: Iran awaits US move after WSJ report says Trump rejects peace plan
world.summary: Donald Trump is privately sceptical that Iran will meet his demands and has told his staff that he sees a renewed bombing campaign as likely after the November US midterm elections, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing unnamed US officials.

world.title: China, US to open AI 'communication channel' after summit
world.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping confirmed that they would meet a third and fourth time this year at international summits in China and the United States.

world.title: OpenAI's models accessed US government websites: Report
world.summary: OpenAI's models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bloomberg News reported on Friday (Sep 25).
